description: CALL THIS when the user asks what plays next on Radio 365: "what's coming up", "what's after this song". Returns the upcoming queue.

count.description: Number of upcoming tracks to return, 1-10 (default 5).

name: get_up_next

outputSchema.description: get_up_next response: now-playing plus the upcoming Radio 365 queue with air times (UTC).

_session.description: Chain session: pass _session.session_token back in the next call to continue the chain.

session_token.description: Hex session token; echo it as params._session.session_token to continue.

step.description: Hop number in this chain (1 = chain start).

try_next.description: Suggested follow-up calls, each a pre-compiled {tool, arguments, purpose} payload.

items.description: Pre-compiled next call: copy `arguments` straight into the next tools/call.

arguments.description: Ready-to-use arguments, pre-populated from the current response.

purpose.description: Why this call is the natural next step.
